name: spotifast
description_en: Spotify, native and fast. One lightweight Rust app for your whole library, local playback, and Spotify Connect on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
readme_excerpt: Spotifast Previously Fastpotify. Same native Spotify client, now at spotifast.rocks. The new name starts with version 0.8.0; your existing settings and sign-ins carry over, except when switching the Flatpak installation. Spotify, native and fast. Spotifast is a Spotify client written in Rust with egui. It plays music through librespot. It typically uses 100–250 MB of RAM, while Spotify's desktop app often uses 600 MB to over 1 GB.
